enemies: 8 low leveled monsters for their bones

st.t: Talk to the Odd Old Man in Silvarea, north-east of Varrock, on the path to the Paterdomus temple.
s: Anything I can do to help?

st.t: Kill a giant rat south east of Varrock. After this kill and every other kill in this section, pick up the bone it drops.
Kill the unicorn south east of Varrock.
Kill the bear south east of Varrock.
Kill a ram south of Varrock.
Kill a goblin east of Lumbridge.
Kill a big frog in the Lumbridge Swamp.
Kill a giant bat in the Karamja Volcano Dungeon.
Check that you have all 8 bones: one from each kill above. Go back for any you left behind.
Talk to Fortunato in Draynor Village, and then buy 8 jugs of vinegar from him.
Use the vinegar on pots for 8 pots of vinegar.
Use the bones on the pots of vinegar.
Use one bone in vinegar on the fire by the Odd Old Man. All your bones in vinegar then boil one after another by themselves, leaving you with 8 polished bones. Any fire or range works too.
Give the Odd Old Man the bones.
